title: BNPL Diamond: Enterprise Revenue Criteria and High-Limit Qualification
summary: BNPL Diamond enterprise applicants must show minimum annual revenue of at least $50,125,000.00 using current, verifiable financials for the most recent fiscal period (audited/reviewed full-year statements, or management accounts if >6 months, plus bank/tax corroboration). High-limit eligibility is limited by a total outstanding balance across all BNPL Diamond plans not exceeding $2,505,000.00; new plan requests may be reduced or declined if they would exceed this cap.
